content: Pholu yi bathumwa bahika
Amana kunima mvula kumi yi ya, hanga thombuki hika ku Yelusalemi hakimosi yi Balanabasi; ndati phi Titi hakimosi yi meni.

Yítombuka kwakuna kikuma Nzambi kánzimbwala yenda. Muna lukutakanu lumosi twákota yi bambuta ba luzitu, hanga yibatendwadini Musamu wa Bukheti wuna yílonga kwena batu bana bakonda kala Bayuta. Yízolaku ni kisalu kyama, kina yísala yi kyaki mbati sala, kyakonda kala mupfunu.
Ata Titi, twákala yandi, wákala mungeleki, bámulundikaku mu kumuyotisa;

mbatanana baphangi ba luvunu bákota mukati dya betu. Batu meni babana bákotila mu kitsweki, mu kikhunda kya betu ndangu batuyiba kiphwanza kina twenina kyawu mwena Kidisitu Yesu, balenga tunata mu kihika.
Twábasisilaku keti tangwa dimosi, ndangu kyedika kya Musamu wa Bukheti kyasikila kikuma kya benu.
Kaasi batu babana bakala monika ni baluti mupfunu, buna bákala meni mathadiku, mukuma Nzambi kisiku tala mbunzu za batu- , amana batu meni babana bákalaku yi kima kyahika kya pha.
Kaasi bawu bátambwasa ni Musamu wa Bukheti báphekilawa kikuma kya babana bakonda kala Bayuta, bwosu bámuhekawa Phetelu kikuma kya Bayuta.
Mukuma, Nzambi wuna wamukitula Phetelu thumwa wa Bayuta, yi yandi phi wuna wákhitula meni thumwa wa babana bakondi kala Bayuta.

Buna bábakula khenda zina yítambula meni, hanga Zyaki, Sefwasi yi Yowani bákala hanga makunzi ma Dibundu; bátuheka mboti ya kikesa, Balanabasi yi meni, mu kusongila kidimbu kya kithwadi; ndangu betu thwenda kwena bana bakondi kala Bayuta amana bawu benda kwena Bayuta.
Bátulomba ni twatalaka lwesi baphutu ba Dibundu, kuna Yelusalemi, kyakina phi yídihanina mu kusadilabwa.
Pholu bwisi mambu ma Phetelu ku Atyosi
Kaasi ha kisa Sefwasi ku Atyosi wa Sidiya, hanga mbwisima mambu mandi hana mesu ma batu boosu, kikuma mu kifu kákala.

Kikuma, hana khaku kedi batula batu ba Zyaki, Phetelu kakala dya hakimosi yi batu bana bakondi kala Bayuta. Kaasi kunima kwisa kwa bawu, hanga wuhunikisi kuyambula, wudiyekudi yi batu bana kikuma kákala yi bweya bwa bawu bákota mukhanda.
Baphangi bahika ba Bayuta phi bátambula miza myamina, hanga yandi phi Balanabasi wekasala bukavungalosi meni bwabuna.

Tangwa yímona ni bákalaku kangala hika bukheti, mu kyedika kina kitadidini Musamu wa Bukheti, hanga nzimbudi kwena Sefwasi hana thwala ya batu boosu: «Ho ni ngeyi wenina Muyuta, wazingilaka mu phila ya bana bakondi kala Bayuta, amana konda kuzingila mu phila ya Bayuta, abweti wabálundikila bana bakondi kala Bayuta mu kusadila mikuku mya Bayuta?»
Bayuta yi bana bakondi kala Bayuta bahuluki mu nzila ya lukwikilu
Betu thwenina Bayuta tuka lubutuku lwetu, thweku hanga batu ba makanda mahika bisiku landa mitsiku mya Nzambi.

Bwosu tuzayi ni mutu bámunungisinaku kikuma kya mihangu mya mitsiku, kaasi mu nzila ya lukwikilu mwena Yesu Kidisitu. Betu phi twásya lukwikilu lwetu mwena Yesu Kidisitu, ndangu batúnungisina kikuma kya lukwikilu lwetu mwena Kidisitu, heku ni kikuma kya mihangu mya mitsiku, -mukuma heku mutu banúngisina kikuma kya mitsiku.

Kaasi yuka mu kusanda ni batunungisina mwena Kidisitu, betu phi bátumona basumuki hanga babana bakondi kala Bayuta; bwabuna busongidi ni Kidisitu, yandi wisi lundika batu mu kuhola disumu? Bwalendakanaku!
Yuka ni yitunga hika kina yímwanga, yidisongila meni-meni hanga mutu kisiku lemvuka ku mitsiku.
Kikuma, mu nzila ya mitsiku, yenina meni-meni wafwa, kikuma kya mitsiku, ndangu yizingila mwena Nzambi. Bákhoka ha kitakani hakimosi yi Kidisitu:

ka meni ku hika mbati zinga, kaasi Kidisitu wubati zinga mwena meni; luzingu lwama lwa kimutu, yisilwa zingila mu lukwikilu lwa Mwana wa Nzambi wuna wánzola amana wáditambika yandi-meni kikuma kya meni.
Ndosizoku khenda za Nzambi; mukuma, yuka ni masonga bisima bongila kikuma kya mitsiku, bubati songila ni Kidisitu mu phamba káfwila.
